plava: Pilava & Plava [fr. plu, cp. Vedic plava boat, Russ. plov ship] 1. 헤엄치는, 흐르는, 떠다니는 J V.408 (suplav--atthaṃ 우물을 헤엄치기 위해서=plavana C.). -- 2. 일종의 오리 [so Epic Sk.] Vv 35Q (cp. VvA 163); J V.420.
plavati: Pilavati & Plavati [cp. Vedic plavati; plu, as in Lat. pluo to rain, pluvius rain, Gr. ple/w swim, plu/nw wash; Ohg. flouwen etc. to rinse=E. flow] (물에서) 재빨리 움직이다, 헤엄치다, 떠다니다, 대롱거리다 Th 1, 104; Miln 377; VvA 163; DhsA 76. As plavati at J I.336 (verse); Dh 334 (v. l. SS; T. palavati). As palavati at Th 1, 399. -- See also uppalavati (uppluta), opilāpeti, paripalavati.
